module_summary: 8-to-16 width converter: a toggle flag alternates between latching the first valid byte into data_lock and concatenating it with the second byte into data_out with a valid pulse.

anchors.name: flag
anchors.why: Toggles per valid_in; selects latch-first-byte versus emit-16-bit-word, gating data_lock, data_out, valid_out.

anchors.name: data_lock
anchors.why: Holds first input byte until second arrives; becomes upper half of data_out.

anchors.name: valid_in
anchors.why: Input valid qualifying data_in; toggles flag and enables all registers.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: 16-bit output register concatenating data_lock and data_in.

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse when a 16-bit word is produced on data_out.

groups.name: width_packer
groups.description: Buffers first byte and concatenates it with second byte into 16-bit output.

groups.name: pair_control
groups.description: Toggle flag tracking byte parity, gating latch and output valid generation.
